USMLE-style practice · Orthopedics

schatzker — pattern 4

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

After high-energy trauma, a patient has a tibial plateau fracture confined to the medial side. CT shows a medial articular fragment with displacement; the lateral plateau is intact. The examiner specifically notes that both condyles are not fractured. Which Schatzker type best matches the CT description?

  1. Type IV
  2. Type V
  3. Type VI
  4. Type I
  5. Type II
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Type IV

Type IV: A fracture involving the medial tibial plateau.

Understanding the options

Type IV
Type IV: A fracture involving the medial tibial plateau.
Type V
Type V describes a bicondylar tibial plateau fracture without complete metaphyseal-diaphyseal dissociation. The case instead matches Type IV.
Type VI
Type VI describes a plateau fracture with metaphyseal-diaphyseal dissociation. The case instead matches Type IV.
Type I
Type I describes a pure split of the lateral tibial plateau without articular depression. The case instead matches Type IV.
Type II
Type II describes a lateral plateau split combined with articular depression. The case instead matches Type IV.
